summary: Century Communities filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026 reporting a First Amendment to its November 1, 2024 credit agreement with U.S. Bank as administrative agent. The amendment raises aggregate commitments to $1.20 billion, adds Flagstar Bank and Morgan Stanley Senior Funding as lenders, designates BMO a non-extending lender, extends the facility termination date for extending lenders to November 1, 2030, eliminates the 0.10% SOFR credit spread adjustment, and resets the tangible net worth covenant floor to roughly $1.77 billion plus 50% of future equity proceeds and net income. This is an ordinary credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
